cases.title: Omit non-copyable UI widgets from clipboard content
cases.description: Verify that copying page content containing UI widgets correctly omits the non-copyable widgets from the resulting clipboard content, leaving only selectable content.

cases.title: Cut, copy, and paste text within dialog box text fields
cases.description: Verify that text can be successfully cut, copied, and pasted from and to text fields located within a dialog box.

cases.title: Drag text or image link between browser windows
cases.description: Verify that dragging a text link or image link from one browser window and dropping it into another browser window opens the link in the target window.

cases.title: Drag link from browser window to desktop
cases.description: Verify that dragging a link from the browser window and dropping it onto the operating system desktop creates a corresponding shortcut.

cases.title: Drag image across browser windows
cases.description: Verify that dragging an image from one browser window to another browser window opens the image in the target window.

cases.title: Drag image onto desktop
cases.description: Verify that dragging an image from the browser window onto the desktop saves the image file to the desktop.

cases.title: Drag link or image to and from frame-set pages
cases.description: Verify that dragging a link or image to a frame-set page properly replaces the entire window contents, and dragging from within a frame-set page replaces the target frame.

cases.title: Drag images and rich text to an editor window
cases.description: Verify that images and rich text can be successfully dragged from a browser window into an external editor window.

cases.title: Drag text, links, and images to a non-modal dialog
cases.description: Verify that text, links, and images can be dragged and dropped into a non-modal dialog successfully.

cases.title: Drag directory to browser window
cases.description: Verify that dragging a directory from the file system into the browser window displays the folder contents.

cases.title: Drag Internet shortcut to browser window
cases.description: Verify that dragging an Internet shortcut file onto the browser window opens the corresponding URL.

cases.title: Drag text file to browser window
cases.description: Verify that dragging a text file onto the browser window displays the document contents inside the browser.

cases.title: Drag supported image file to browser window
cases.description: Verify that dragging a supported image file onto the browser window displays the image correctly.

cases.title: Drag files, folders, or shortcuts from Find File window
cases.description: Verify that files, folders, or shortcuts dragged from a Find File utility window will open or display correctly in the browser window.

cases.title: Drag files onto the application icon
cases.description: Verify that files dragged and dropped directly onto the application execution icon are successfully opened and displayed.

cases.title: Drag URL proxy icon to a browser window
cases.description: Verify that dragging the URL proxy icon to a browser window opens that URL in the target window.

cases.title: Drag URL proxy icon from location bar to desktop
cases.description: Verify that dragging the URL proxy icon from the location bar onto the desktop creates a functional shortcut.

cases.title: Handle items dragged from the Bookmark Manager
cases.description: Verify that the application and operating system correctly handle items dragged outward from the Bookmark Manager.

cases.title: Handle items dragged onto the Bookmark Manager
cases.description: Verify that the Bookmark Manager correctly receives and processes items dragged onto it.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, appropriately mapped to their respective requirements, and present no blockers or untestable scenarios.
All requirements and test cases are clear, valid, and properly mapped. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: R-019: Testable behavior is the exclusion of non-copyable UI widgets from clipboard data. Boundary is content marked non-copyable versus selectable content. Normal path copies selected page content while omitting widgets; abnormal path attempts copying non-copyable widgets resulting in empty or filtered clipboard. Ambiguity: definition of UI widgets. R-020: Testable behavior includes cutting, copying, and pasting text inside dialog text fields. Boundaries are dialog text fields versus normal page text. Normal path performs standard clipboard ops successfully; abnormal path involves restricted fields or empty selections. Ambiguity: modal vs non-modal dialogs. R-021: Dragging text or image links between browser windows. Boundary is source and target window contexts. Normal path opens link in target window; abnormal path drops on non-droppable areas. Ambiguity: handling of new tabs vs existing windows. R-022: Dragging a link to the desktop creates a shortcut. Boundary is browser canvas to OS desktop. Normal path creates valid OS shortcut (.url); abnormal path drops onto invalid OS regions. Ambiguity: OS-specific shortcut format. R-023: Dragging an image across browser windows opens the image. Boundary is inter-window drop. Normal path opens image in target; abnormal path drops outside viewport. Ambiguity: target window navigation behavior. R-024: Dragging an image to the desktop saves it. Boundary is browser to desktop. Normal path saves image file to disk; abnormal path drops invalid data. Ambiguity: default filename resolution. R-025: Frame-set page drop behavior. Boundary is dropping onto frame-set vs within frame-set. Normal path replaces entire window for link/image drop or target frame for internal frame drag; abnormal path involves nested invalid frames. Ambiguity: frame boundary detection. R-026: Dragging images and rich text to an editor window. Boundary is browser application to external editor. Normal path transfers rich content correctly; abnormal path drops into unsupported editors. Ambiguity: definition of editor window. R-027: Dragging text, links, and images to a non-modal dialog. Boundary is main window to non-modal dialog. Normal path accepts dropped content; abnormal path drops on modal dialogs if restricted. Ambiguity: visual feedback during drag over dialog. R-028: Dragging a directory to the browser window. Boundary is OS file system to browser. Normal path displays folder contents; abnormal path drags invalid directory path. Ambiguity: OS file listing format. R-029: Dragging an Internet shortcut to the browser window. Boundary is OS shortcut file to browser. Normal path opens URL; abnormal path uses corrupt shortcut file. Ambiguity: handling of broken shortcuts. R-030: Dragging a text file to the browser window. Boundary is text file to browser viewport. Normal path displays document contents; abnormal path drops non-text files. Ambiguity: character encoding detection. R-031: Dragging supported image files to the browser. Boundary is image file to browser. Normal path displays image; abnormal path drops unsupported formats. Ambiguity: list of supported image formats. R-032: Dragging files, folders, or shortcuts from Find File window. Boundary is search utility window to browser. Normal path opens items; abnormal path drops missing file paths. Ambiguity: OS search tool variations. R-033: Dragging files onto the application icon. Boundary is OS shell icon to application process. Normal path displays file; abnormal path drops locked or invalid files. Ambiguity: OS-specific icon drop handling. R-034: Dragging URL proxy icon to a browser window. Boundary is location bar proxy icon to window viewport. Normal path opens URL in target window; abnormal path drops outside valid drop zones. Ambiguity: target window selection if multiple exist. R-035: Dragging URL proxy icon to desktop. Boundary is location bar to OS desktop. Normal path creates desktop shortcut; abnormal path drops on restricted OS areas. Ambiguity: shortcut naming convention. R-036: Dragging items from Bookmark Manager. Boundary is Bookmark Manager UI to browser/OS. Normal path successfully handles dragged items; abnormal path drags malformed bookmarks. Ambiguity: destination types allowed. R-037: Dragging items onto Bookmark Manager. Boundary is external/internal source to Bookmark Manager. Normal path adds items to bookmarks; abnormal path drops unsupported types. Ambiguity: drop target precision within Bookmark Manager tree.
